patch.text: When reading the brief’s key (e.g., "C#m" or "Eb major"), preserve the accidental symbol (# or b) and the mode (major/minor) exactly as given; do not strip or alter them, and do not substitute the relative major/minor unless explicitly asked.

patch.text: When writing the bass part, ensure the bass emphasizes the root note of the key (tonic) rather than the fifth: start each bar on the root, and avoid making the fifth the most frequent or loudest note in the bass track.

patch.text: After arranging the track, run `detect_key` on the mixed audio.
